name: Celeste
short_description: Climb a mountain as Madeline, one tight jump-and-dash screen at a time, while facing her anxiety.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Climb a mountain as Madeline, one tight jump-and-dash screen at a time, while facing her anxiety.

identity.core_loop: Read a screen, jump, dash, climb, die, respawn instantly, try again, clear it, next screen.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Tight and generous; coyote time and input buffering make it feel fair.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Madeline's hair colour shows whether her dash is ready; everything else is the level itself. Almost no HUD.

identity.art_direction: Crisp pixel art with soft lighting and particle wind.

rendering.source: derived from the art note by rendering_notes.RULES

tricks: Few-frame pixel animation with strong squash and stretch on jump, land and dash
Madeline's hair trails behind her as a chain of follow-through blobs and changes colour when her dash is spent
Dust puffs and a brief freeze on dash sell speed in a handful of frames
motion.lesson: Follow-through on one element (hair, scarf, tail) plus squash on landing makes a tiny sprite feel alive; let it carry state too.
motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.audio_mood: Piano and synth score that shifts per chapter.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Hair that changes colour when the dash is spent is the best one-signal readout we know; instant respawn makes hard things kind.
